description:
Goal: cut the orchestrator (chief-of-staff) skill-load from 11 -> ~4 by re-homing each deployed skill to where its work actually happens. Verified mechanism (gsearch 2026-06-15): skills load by progressive disclosure (name+desc ~30-100 tok each into EVERY orchestrator session); the 12 CAPTAIN envelopes carry NO Skill tool today, so all 11 skills currently load only onto the orchestrators (POLYBIUS/PLINY/floor-manager). Token win is small (~0.5-1k tok); the real win is routing clarity + putting each skill where its work happens.

DISPOSITIONS (PRINCIPAL-decided 2026-06-15):

1. agent-author -> NEW seat MAJOR_CHIRON (orchestrator tier; 3rd standing seat alongside POLYBIUS/PLINY). Carries a trimmed MAJOR_POLYBIUS-derived role file + the agent-author skill as its EXCLUSIVE skill (first/only seat granted a scoped Skill tool). Scope: team-composition judgments + authoring agent envelopes. Shipped in the default team. Name hook: Chiron, the centaur tutor who formed Achilles/Jason/Asclepius.

2. check-substrate-updates + check-bw-release -> deterministic SessionStart TRIGGER, not orchestrator-routed skills. Guardrails: throttle (cache, ~once/day per workspace), surface-on-signal-only (silent when current; one line on drift/new-release), non-blocking (never gate boot on a network call). Existing modules: substrate-update-check.md, bw-upgrade.md. Integrates with the check-substrate lifecycle in stoa--sp1.

3. save-verdict / validate-spec / inspect-script-output -> MODULES the dispatched specialist Reads at dispatch (Read .claude/modules/<X>.md), not orchestrator skills. save-verdict: drop the SCRIPT for Bash-only body-authoring baked into the module -> retires stoa--j2i, stoa--1ne, stoa--xyn, stoa--7b1.8. Resolve the review-seat no-Write vs mandates-save-verdict tension (stoa--7b1.1) in the same arc. inspect-script-output relates to existing module mechanical-inspection-split.md.

4. credential-discipline -> DEFERRED until the new project version lands (PRINCIPAL). Likely retires into existing modules credential-discipline-detail.md + credential-flow-design.md.

5. KEPT as orchestrator skills: handoff-author, workflow-composer, team-launcher, interactive-html-preview. (interactive-html-preview disposition tentative: keep unless PRINCIPAL re-homes it.)

install.sh impact: add MAJOR_CHIRON to the MAJOR deploy set + its scoped Skill grant (the ONLY skill-granted seat); shrink SKILL_NAMES; add the re-homed modules; add a SessionStart check-trigger hook. Fleet-wide redeploy after, NOMOS-verified.

Wires into: stoa--rdh (SKILL_NAMES wiring), stoa--sp1 (skill portfolio + lifecycle), stoa--xyb.2 (skill-grant reachability finding). Net: chief-of-staff skill menu 11 -> ~4; MAJOR_CHIRON = first seat with a scoped Skill grant.
title: [ROADMAP] Skill-architecture rationalization: MAJOR_CHIRON agent-author seat + re-home specialist skills off the chief-of-staff
